versions.subject: Merge PR #4961 from @tsale - Add multiples rules and updates
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\7zFM.exe'
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\cmd.exe'
          - '\powershell.exe'
          - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'Cmd.Exe'
          - 'PowerShell.EXE'
          - 'pwsh.dll'
filter_main_extensions_and_flags:
    - CommandLine|contains:
          - ' /c '
          - ' /k '
          - ' /r '
    - CommandLine|endswith:
          - '.bat'
          - '.cmd'
          - '.ps1'
filter_main_null:
    CommandLine: null
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\7zFM.exe" Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("Cmd.Exe", "PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll") NOT (CommandLine IN ("* /c *", "* /k *", "* /r *") OR CommandLine IN ("*.bat", "*.cmd", "*.ps1") OR NOT CommandLine=*)
